source_snapshot.procedure: Confirm SUT configuration, clear logs, use SF100 to write BIOS code to the ROM, repeat the write 50 times, put the ROM back into the SUT, power on and boot into BIOS; then collect results/photos and unexpected logs.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: SF100 is a physical SPI flash/debug tool requiring an operator to connect the programmer; the remote agent cannot attach the hardware.

original_test_intent.purpose: Exercise the same approved BIOS SPI ROM through exactly 50 qualified SF100 program cycles using the same approved BIOS image, then reinstall/reconnect that ROM as the source requires and prove that the SUT boots into BIOS normally.
original_test_intent.target: One positively identified board and BIOS SPI NOR device, its exact voltage/interface/adaptor and one approved image/hash; not a different ROM, board, backup device or changing image across cycles.
original_test_intent.scope: Physical ROM/programmer setup, 50 erase/program/verify sequences as defined by the approved SF100 procedure, per-cycle traceability, physical reinstallation/restoration and final BIOS/POST/platform-health validation. It is not a single readback or one flash followed by 49 counters.
original_test_intent.operation: A qualified operator isolates power/ESD, identifies and removes or connects the exact ROM according to the board procedure, validates SF100 device/firmware/software, adapter, orientation and voltage, then an approved local controller executes and logs 50 complete program/verify cycles, stopping on any anomaly; the operator reinstalls/restores the ROM and performs a controlled boot into BIOS for final evidence.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: Exactly 50 successful program/verify attempts on the same ROM/image. The source lists 15 attended and 600 machine minutes; elapsed time does not replace the 50-cycle count and a failed cycle must not be silently excluded or retried.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Every approved cycle completes its programmed operation and verification with traceable data, the ROM is restored to the target board correctly, BIOS/POST boots with the expected image/version/settings, and no unexplained SPI/board/BMC/SEL or recovery fault remains.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: Board/ROM part/JEDEC/serial identity and pre-read backup/hash, SF100 hardware/firmware/software/adapter/cable identity, image provenance/hash, exact VCC/VPP/SPI/operation configuration, cycle-numbered erase/program/verify results and duration, failure/retry record, physical handling/reinstallation photos, final readback/hash, BIOS/POST/version/configuration and platform-health evidence.
ambiguities: The source does not identify the ROM, package/socket, whether it is removed or in-system programmed, image, erase/program/verify sequence, voltage, clock, write protection, failure policy or firmware settings.
'Put the ROM back' implies physical removal/restoration, whereas DeepSeek assumes in-circuit programming; the owner must select the exact approved board-specific method.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly preserves all 50 writes, physical SF100/ROM handling, per-cycle verification, image/ROM/voltage identity, stable power, ESD and recovery. It classifies the entire case MANUAL ONLY even though official SF100 software provides program/verify and batch operations that can automate the 50-cycle segment after qualified manual fixture/ROM setup.

applicable_history.decision: The historical handoff records this testcase as an independently completed V2 row with matching DeepSeek and source evidence.
The earlier review retained the physical SF100 boundary and the 50-write ROM durability purpose.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: V3 treats this as a hybrid workflow: ROM/SF100 connection, removal/reinstallation and final physical recovery remain manual, while the exact 50-cycle Program/Verify sequence and evidence capture are technically automatable through approved SF100 software after setup. High brick risk remains fully gated.

available_now: The source fixes the purpose, same ROM stress, exact count of 50 writes and final boot-into-BIOS check.
DediProg's official SF100 resources provide SPI NOR programming software, a batch-operation facility and an in-system programming application note, supporting hybrid automation after physical setup.
Board/BIOS/BMC inventory, image hashing and recovery planning can be completed without writing the ROM.
missing_inputs: Exact board/SPI ROM part/package/JEDEC ID, socketed-removal versus approved in-system method, orientation/adaptor/cable/pinout and board isolation requirements
Approved BIOS image/provenance/hash, baseline dump/hash, intended final configuration and known-good recovery image/device
SF100 hardware/firmware/software build/hash/license, supported-device profile, VCC/VPP/SPI clock, erase/program/verify/batch settings and write-protect handling
Qualified operator, ESD/stable power, maintenance isolation, cycle failure/retry policy, evidence storage, controlled reinstall/boot/KVM/OOB and recovery owner
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The BIOS/board owner supplies ROM/image/recovery and final BIOS expectations; the programmer/vendor owner supplies supported-device/profile/settings; the lab owner supplies operator, ESD/power/maintenance and physical recovery coverage.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Collect board/BIOS/BMC identity, image/hash/provenance, SF100/tool inventory and existing health/log evidence without connecting or powering the programmer
Review the exact ROM support and VCC/VPP/SPI/batch configuration offline; prepare immutable cycle-numbered log storage and recovery manifests
prohibited_until_closed: Do not connect the clip/socket, remove a ROM, apply programmer power, erase/program, change VCC/VPP/clock/write protection or power the SUT before exact identity/settings/isolation approval

revision_candidate.test_name: SF100 BIOS SPI ROM 50-Cycle Program Durability
revision_candidate.purpose: Program and verify the same approved BIOS image on the same target SPI ROM exactly 50 times with the qualified SF100 setup, then restore the ROM to the SUT and verify normal BIOS boot and platform health.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact board/SPI NOR/BIOS combination with owner-approved SF100 hardware, firmware, software and adapter/profile, stable isolated power, ESD controls, qualified operator, KVM/OOB and independent recovery.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One specified ROM and one immutable image across all 50 cycles. Physical removal/reinstallation or in-system connection must follow the selected board procedure; no other firmware/device is in scope.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Board/ROM identity and support; programming topology; adapter/pinout/orientation; SF100 hardware/firmware/software/profile; VCC/VPP/SPI/write-protect and operation settings; image/baseline/recovery hashes; exact 50-cycle semantics and retry policy; operator/ESD/power/approval; evidence, reinstall, boot and recovery procedures.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: After manual target isolation and qualified SF100/ROM setup, preserve the ROM baseline, run the approved local SF100 Program/Verify sequence for cycle 1 through 50 with immutable image/settings and cycle-numbered raw logs, abort on any discrepancy, obtain final readback verification, have the operator reinstall/restore the ROM as specified, perform one controlled SUT boot and record BIOS/POST/version/configuration plus platform health.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Exact ROM/image/profile/settings two-person verified; backup and independent recovery proven; programmer/tool integrity and device support confirmed; stable power/ESD/board isolation; operator and evidence storage ready; failure/retry rule approved; SUT workloads isolated; KVM/OOB available; logs preserved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Approval manifest; board/ROM IDs; pre-read backup/hash; image hash; SF100 hardware/firmware/software/profile/settings; cycle 1-50 raw erase/program/verify status, timestamps and durations; all failures/retries; final readback/hash; physical setup/restoration photos; BIOS/POST/version/configuration; BMC/SEL and health/recovery evidence.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The board/BIOS owner's SPI programming and recovery procedure, ROM manufacturer limits/support data, and the exact DediProg SF100 hardware/software/device-profile documentation approved for the target.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Never guess ROM/profile/voltage/pinout/image, energize conflicting board/programmer supplies, enable VPP unless explicitly supported, continue after any anomaly, hide retries, substitute devices/images, clear logs or claim final success from a programmer PASS without reinstall/BIOS boot/health evidence.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Qualified personnel perform all ROM/chassis/programmer connection and restoration. BIOS/board owners approve the exact image/settings, irreversible 50-cycle start and any recovery; the agent may automate only the preapproved software loop and evidence capture.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: ROM removal/reinstallation or probe connection, physical identity/orientation, board power isolation and final restoration are manual. The 50-cycle SF100 software sequence and raw log collection may be automated after the manual gate; recovery remains operator-controlled.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On identification, erase/program/verify, communication, voltage or boot anomaly, stop the campaign at the recorded cycle, preserve the ROM and logs, isolate power safely, avoid blind retries, use only the validated backup/recovery image/device path, then verify BIOS/POST/platform health or quarantine the board/ROM.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Board/ROM/image/profile mismatch, unsupported device, uncertain voltage/pinout/topology, unstable or conflicting power, write/verify/readback difference, unrecorded retry, operator/monitoring/evidence loss, physical damage, failed reinstall, POST/BIOS mismatch, management/SEL fault or unavailable recovery.

identified_defects: V2 classifies the entire hybrid operation MANUAL ONLY although official SF100 software supports batch Program/Verify automation after manual setup.
DeepSeek assumes an in-circuit probe while the source explicitly says to put the ROM back into the SUT; the board-specific programming topology is unresolved.
The source omits the device profile, voltage and per-cycle failure/retry semantics needed for a valid 50-cycle durability result.
reason_for_change: Represent the actual hybrid capability without claiming remote physical handling, preserve the source's exact 50 writes and ROM restoration, and bind each cycle to immutable target/image/settings and a stop-on-first-anomaly evidence contract.

new_technical_evidence.title: SF100 SPI NOR Flash Programmer
new_technical_evidence.version: Product resources accessed 2026-10-13; SF Software User Manual v1.0 and In-System Programming Application Note v1.3 listed
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Only an SF100 hardware/firmware/software/device profile qualified for the exact ROM
new_technical_evidence.supports: The vendor provides SF100 software and an in-system programming application note, so programming can be software-controlled after physical setup; current resources also distinguish SF100 firmware generations.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The repository does not identify the SF100 revision, software, adapter, ROM support profile or whether this board uses offline or in-system programming.

new_technical_evidence.title: DediProg SF Software User Manual
new_technical_evidence.supports: The software exposes Batch Operations and Program/Verify controls and selectable VCC values; VPP is conditional on flash support. These features support an automated loop but require exact target-specific settings.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The target ROM's required voltage/VPP/clock and approved batch configuration are unknown.

removed_ambiguities: Defines all 50 cycles as the same ROM/image/settings with cycle-numbered Program/Verify evidence.
Separates manual physical topology/restoration from automatable SF100 software operations.
Treats source `put the ROM back` as a required restoration step unless the owner formally corrects the programming topology.
resolved_blockers: The hardware fixture and proprietary software are provisionable dependencies; after qualified manual setup, the repeated programming and evidence loop is technically automatable.
remaining_blockers: No programmer connection or write until ROM/board/image/topology/profile/voltage, operator, failure policy, approval and independent recovery are verified.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 recognizes the vendor-supported hybrid automation segment instead of making the entire case MANUAL ONLY, while strengthening the 50-cycle invariant, source-required ROM restoration, voltage/profile controls, first-failure stop rule and per-cycle evidence; no physical or brick-risk boundary is relaxed.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The isolated validator preserved exactly 50 numbered program/verify cycles on one ROM and image, no hidden retry, final readback and one controlled SUT boot.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: The source requires the same BIOS ROM to be written with SF100 50 times, put back into the SUT and booted into BIOS.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 preserves the cycle/safety evidence but calls all work manual; V3 uses official SF100 software evidence to separate manual setup from automatable Program/Verify cycles.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: No connection or write before exact ROM/image/profile/voltage/topology and recovery approval; stop on the first recorded anomaly and never hide retries or continue blindly.
